<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>CRM Weisz</title>
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/react@18/umd/react.production.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18/umd/react-dom.production.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone/babel.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2/dist/umd/supabase.min.js"></script>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
  <style>
    *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
    :root{
      --bg-main:#0f0f13;--bg-sidebar:#0a0a0e;--bg-card:#13131a;--bg-input:#0f0f16;
      --bg-hover:#16161f;--bg-pill:#1e1e2e;--border:#1e1e2e;--border2:#1a1a24;
      --text-main:#e2e8f0;--text-sub:#94a3b8;--text-dim:#64748b;--text-mute:#475569;--text-faint:#374151;
      --accent:#6366f1;--accent2:#8b5cf6;--accent-soft:#a78bfa;--shadow:rgba(99,102,241,0.15);
      color-scheme:dark;
    }
    [data-theme="light"]{
      --bg-main:#f1f5f9;--bg-sidebar:#ffffff;--bg-card:#ffffff;--bg-input:#f8fafc;
      --bg-hover:#f0f4ff;--bg-pill:#e8eaf6;--border:#e2e8f0;--border2:#edf2f7;
      --text-main:#0f172a;--text-sub:#334155;--text-dim:#475569;--text-mute:#64748b;--text-faint:#94a3b8;
      --accent:#4f46e5;--accent2:#7c3aed;--accent-soft:#6366f1;--shadow:rgba(79,70,229,0.1);
      color-scheme:light;
    }
    body{background:var(--bg-main);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--text-main);transition:background .3s,color .3s}
    input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit}
    input::placeholder,textarea::placeholder{color:var(--text-faint)}
    ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg-main)}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border);border-radius:2px}
    @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
    @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
    @keyframes slideIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(0.97)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
    .fade-in{animation:fadeIn .2s ease}.slide-in{animation:slideIn .18s ease}
    tr:hover td{background:var(--bg-hover)!important;transition:background .1s}
    .toggle-btn{width:40px;height:22px;background:var(--bg-pill);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:11px;cursor:pointer;position:relative;transition:background .3s;flex-shrink:0;outline:none}
    .toggle-btn::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);transition:transform .3s,background .3s}
    [data-theme="light"] .toggle-btn::after{transform:translateX(18px)}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="root"></div>
<script type="text/babel">
const {useState,useEffect,useRef} = React;
const {createClient} = supabase;
const SUPA_URL  = "https://jvxssobcjtkdcfdsqnst.supabase.co";
const SUPA_ANON = "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6Imp2eHNzb2JjanRrZGNmZHNxbnN0Iiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3Nzg3NDkxMzEsImV4cCI6MjA5NDMyNTEzMX0.HN_o4CMMFhtTgPfN1SmX6hl134KPKou0dKosypLMWgs";
const db = createClient(SUPA_URL,SUPA_ANON);

const LOGO_DARK  = "";
const LOGO_LIGHT = "";

const ST={
  "Pendiente":  {color:"#f59e0b",bg:"rgba(245,158,11,0.12)",dot:"#f59e0b"},
  "En progreso":{color:"#3b82f6",bg:"rgba(59,130,246,0.12)",dot:"#3b82f6"},
  "Completado": {color:"#10b981",bg:"rgba(16,185,129,0.12)",dot:"#10b981"},
};
const PR={
  "Alta": {color:"#ef4444",bg:"rgba(239,68,68,0.12)"},
  "Media":{color:"#f97316",bg:"rgba(249,115,22,0.12)"},
  "Baja": {color:"#6b7280",bg:"rgba(107,114,128,0.12)"},
};
const STAGES={
  "Recibida":     {color:"#06b6d4",bg:"rgba(6,182,212,0.12)"},
  "En elaboración":{color:"#f59e0b",bg:"rgba(245,158,11,0.12)"},
  "Enviada":      {color:"#10b981",bg:"rgba(16,185,129,0.12)"},
};
const SEMAFORO={
  "verde":    {color:"#10b981",label:"Verde"},
  "amarillo": {color:"#f59e0b",label:"Amarillo"},
  "rojo":     {color:"#ef4444",label:"Rojo"},
};
const AVC=["#8b5cf6","#06b6d4","#f43f5e","#10b981","#f59e0b","#3b82f6","#ec4899","#14b8a6"];
const avc=s=>AVC[(s?.charCodeAt(0)||0)%AVC.length];
const ini=n=>n?.split(" ").map(x=>x[0]).join("").toUpperCase().slice(0,2)||"?";
const fd=d=>d?new Date(d+"T12:00:00").toLocaleDateString("es-CO",{day:"2-digit",month:"short"}):"—";
const fdl=d=>d?new Date(d+"T12:00:00").toLocaleDateString("es-CO",{day:"2-digit",month:"long",year:"numeric"}):"Sin fecha";
const fdt=d=>d?new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("es-CO",{day:"2-digit",month:"short",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"}):"";
const cv=n=>`var(${n})`;
const fmt=n=>new Intl.NumberFormat("es-CO",{style:"currency",currency:"COP",minimumFractionDigits:0}).format(n||0);

const Inp=({label,...p})=>(
  <div style={{marginBottom:14}}>
    {label&&<label style={{display:"block",fontSize:10,color:cv("--text-dim"),marginBottom:5,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"0.5px"}}>{label}</label>}
    <input {...p} style={{width:"100%",background:cv("--bg-input"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 12px",color:cv("--text-main"),fontSize:13,outline:"none",...p.style}}/>
  </div>
);
const Sel=({label,children,...p})=>(
  <div style={{marginBottom:14}}>
    {label&&<label style={{display:"block",fontSize:10,color:cv("--text-dim"),marginBottom:5,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"0.5px"}}>{label}</label>}
    <select {...p} style={{width:"100%",background:cv("--bg-input"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 12px",color:cv("--text-main"),fontSize:13,outline:"none",...p.style}}>{children}</select>
  </div>
);
const Btn=({children,variant="primary",...p})=>(
  <button {...p} style={{padding:"10px 18px",border:"none",borderRadius:10,fontFamily:"inherit",fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer",
    background:variant==="primary"?`linear-gradient(135deg,${cv("--accent")},${cv("--accent2")})`:variant==="danger"?"transparent":cv("--bg-pill"),
    color:variant==="danger"?"#ef4444":variant==="secondary"?cv("--text-dim"):"white",
    border:variant==="danger"?`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`:"none",
    opacity:p.disabled?0.6:1,...p.style}}>{children}</button>
);

// ── AUTH ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function AuthScreen({theme,toggleTheme}){
  const [mode,setMode]=useState("login");
  const [form,setForm]=useState({email:"",password:"",name:""});
  const [err,setErr]=useState("");
  const [ok,setOk]=useState("");
  const [load,setLoad]=useState(false);
  const logo=theme==="dark"?`data:image/png;base64,${LOGO_DARK}`:`data:image/png;base64,${LOGO_LIGHT}`;

  const go=async()=>{
    setErr("");setLoad(true);setOk("");
    if(mode==="login"){
      const{error}=await db.auth.signInWithPassword({email:form.email,password:form.password});
      if(error)setErr(error.message);
    }else{
      const{data,error}=await db.auth.signUp({email:form.email,password:form.password,options:{data:{name:form.name}}});
      if(error){setErr(error.message);setLoad(false);return;}
      if(data.user)await db.from("users").insert({id:data.user.id,name:form.name,email:form.email,avatar:ini(form.name)});
      setOk("¡Cuenta creada! Ahora inicia sesión.");setMode("login");
    }
    setLoad(false);
  };

  return(
    <div style={{minHeight:"100vh",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",padding:24,background:cv("--bg-main"),transition:"background .3s"}}>
      <button onClick={toggleTheme} className="toggle-btn" style={{position:"fixed",top:20,right:20}} title="Cambiar tema"/>
      <div style={{width:"100%",maxWidth:400}}>
        <div style={{textAlign:"center",marginBottom:32}}>
          <img src={logo} alt="Weisz" style={{height:56,maxWidth:280,objectFit:"contain",margin:"0 auto 16px",display:"block"}}/>
          <p style={{color:cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:11,letterSpacing:"3px",textTransform:"uppercase"}}>Sistema CRM</p>
        </div>
        <div style={{background:cv("--bg-card"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:20,padding:28,boxShadow:`0 8px 40px var(--shadow)`}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",background:cv("--bg-input"),borderRadius:10,padding:4,marginBottom:22}}>
            {["login","register"].map(m=>(
              <button key={m} onClick={()=>{setMode(m);setErr("");setOk("");}}
                style={{flex:1,padding:"8px",borderRadius:7,border:"none",background:mode===m?cv("--bg-pill"):"transparent",color:mode===m?cv("--accent-soft"):cv("--text-dim"),fontWeight:mode===m?600:400,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",transition:"all .15s"}}>
                {m==="login"?"Iniciar sesión":"Registrarse"}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {mode==="register"&&<Inp label="Nombre completo" placeholder="Tu nombre" value={form.name} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,name:e.target.value})}/>}
          <Inp label="Email" type="email" placeholder="tu@weisz.com.co" value={form.email} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,email:e.target.value})}/>
          <Inp label="Contraseña" type="password" placeholder="••••••••" value={form.password} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,password:e.target.value})} onKeyDown={e=>e.key==="Enter"&&go()}/>
          {err&&<div style={{background:"rgba(239,68,68,0.08)",border:"1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.2)",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 12px",color:"#ef4444",fontSize:12,marginBottom:14}}>{err}</div>}
          {ok&&<div style={{background:"rgba(16,185,129,0.08)",border:"1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.2)",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 12px",color:"#10b981",fontSize:12,marginBottom:14}}>{ok}</div>}
          <Btn onClick={go} disabled={load} style={{width:"100%",padding:"12px",fontSize:14}}>{load?"...":(mode==="login"?"Entrar al sistema":"Crear cuenta")}</Btn>
        </div>
        <p style={{textAlign:"center",color:cv("--text-faint"),fontSize:10,marginTop:16,letterSpacing:"1.5px",textTransform:"uppercase"}}>Instrumentos · Ingeniería · Control</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── OPORTUNIDADES MODULE ──────────────────────────────────
function OpportunitiesModule({users,session,theme}){
  const [opps,setOpps]=useState([]);
  const [clients,setClients]=useState([]);
  const [filter,setFilter]=useState("Todas");
  const [search,setSearch]=useState("");
  const [selOpp,setSelOpp]=useState(null);
  const [showNew,setShowNew]=useState(false);
  const [saving,setSaving]=useState(false);
  const [comments,setComments]=useState([]);
  const [newComment,setNewComment]=useState("");
  const [commentFile,setCommentFile]=useState(null);
  const [loadingComments,setLoadingComments]=useState(false);
  const fileRef=useRef();
  const [no,setNo]=useState({name:"",client_name:"",stage:"Recibida",assignee_id:"",email_subject:"",quick_note:"",status:"verde",sent_date:""});

  useEffect(()=>{fetchOpps();fetchClients();},[]);

  const fetchOpps=async()=>{
    const{data}=await db.from("opportunities")
      .select("*, assignee:users(id,name)")
      .order("updated_at",{ascending:false});
    setOpps(data||[]);
  };

  const fetchClients=async()=>{
    const{data}=await db.from("clients").select("*").order("name");
    setClients(data||[]);
  };

  const fetchComments=async(oppId)=>{
    setLoadingComments(true);
    const{data}=await db.from("opportunity_comments")
      .select("*, user:users(id,name), files:opportunity_files(id,original_name,storage_path,mime_type)")
      .eq("opportunity_id",oppId)
      .order("created_at",{ascending:true});
    setComments(data||[]);
    setLoadingComments(false);
  };

  const openOpp=async(opp)=>{
    setSelOpp(opp);
    await fetchComments(opp.id);
  };

  const createOpp=async()=>{
    if(!no.client_name)return;
    setSaving(true);
    await db.from("opportunities").insert({...no,assignee_id:no.assignee_id||null,sent_date:no.sent_date||null,created_by:session.user.id});
    await fetchOpps();
    setShowNew(false);
    setNo({name:"",client_name:"",stage:"Recibida",assignee_id:"",email_subject:"",quick_note:"",status:"verde",sent_date:""});
    setSaving(false);
  };

  const updateStage=async(id,cur)=>{
    const order=["Recibida","En elaboración","Enviada"];
    const next=order[(order.indexOf(cur)+1)%3];
    await db.from("opportunities").update({stage:next}).eq("id",id);
    setOpps(opps.map(o=>o.id===id?{...o,stage:next}:o));
    if(selOpp?.id===id)setSelOpp({...selOpp,stage:next});
  };

  const updateStatus=async(id,cur)=>{
    const order=["verde","amarillo","rojo"];
    const next=order[(order.indexOf(cur)+1)%3];
    await db.from("opportunities").update({status:next}).eq("id",id);
    setOpps(opps.map(o=>o.id===id?{...o,status:next}:o));
    if(selOpp?.id===id)setSelOpp({...selOpp,status:next});
  };

  const addComment=async()=>{
    if(!newComment.trim()&&!commentFile)return;
    setSaving(true);
    const{data:commentData}=await db.from("opportunity_comments").insert({
      opportunity_id:selOpp.id,
      user_id:session.user.id,
      comment:newComment.trim()||"Archivo adjunto"
    }).select().single();

    if(commentFile&&commentData){
      const ext=commentFile.name.split(".").pop();
      const path=`${selOpp.id}/${commentData.id}.${ext}`;
      await db.storage.from("opportunity-files").upload(path,commentFile);
      await db.from("opportunity_files").insert({
        opportunity_id:selOpp.id,
        filename:`${commentData.id}.${ext}`,
        original_name:commentFile.name,
        size_bytes:commentFile.size,
        mime_type:commentFile.type,
        storage_path:path,
        uploaded_by:session.user.id
      });
    }
    setNewComment("");setCommentFile(null);
    await fetchComments(selOpp.id);
    await fetchOpps();
    setSaving(false);
  };

  const downloadFile=async(path,name)=>{
    const{data}=await db.storage.from("opportunity-files").download(path);
    if(data){
      const url=URL.createObjectURL(data);
      const a=document.createElement("a");a.href=url;a.download=name;a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }
  };

  const deleteOpp=async(id)=>{
    if(!confirm("¿Eliminar esta oportunidad?"))return;
    await db.from("opportunities").delete().eq("id",id);
    setOpps(opps.filter(o=>o.id!==id));setSelOpp(null);
  };

  const filtered=opps.filter(o=>
    (filter==="Todas"||o.stage===filter)&&
    (!search||o.client_name?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())||o.name?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())||o.email_subject?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
  );

  const stats={
    total:opps.length,
    recibida:opps.filter(o=>o.stage==="Recibida").length,
    elaboracion:opps.filter(o=>o.stage==="En elaboración").length,
    enviada:opps.filter(o=>o.stage==="Enviada").length,
  };

  const cardStyle={background:cv("--bg-card"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,transition:"background .3s,border-color .3s"};

  return(
    <div>
      {/* HEADER */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"space-between",padding:"22px 0 18px",borderBottom:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,marginBottom:24}}>
        <div>
          <h1 style={{fontSize:20,fontWeight:700,letterSpacing:"-0.5px",marginBottom:3,color:cv("--text-main")}}>Oportunidades</h1>
          <p style={{color:cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:12}}>Seguimiento de solicitudes y ofertas</p>
        </div>
        <button onClick={()=>setShowNew(true)} style={{background:`linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2))`,border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"9px 18px",color:"white",fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",boxShadow:`0 4px 20px var(--shadow)`}}>
          + Nueva oportunidad
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* STATS */}
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(4,1fr)",gap:14,marginBottom:24}}>
        {[{l:"Total",n:stats.total,c:"var(--accent)"},{l:"Recibidas",n:stats.recibida,c:"#06b6d4"},{l:"En elaboración",n:stats.elaboracion,c:"#f59e0b"},{l:"Enviadas",n:stats.enviada,c:"#10b981"}].map(s=>(
          <div key={s.l} style={{...cardStyle,borderRadius:12,padding:"16px 18px",boxShadow:theme==="light"?"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)":"none"}}>
            <p style={{color:cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:10,marginBottom:6,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"0.5px"}}>{s.l}</p>
            <p style={{fontSize:30,fontWeight:700,marginBottom:10,color:s.c,fontFamily:"'DM Mono',monospace"}}>{s.n}</p>
            <div style={{height:3,background:cv("--bg-pill"),borderRadius:2}}>
              <div style={{height:"100%",width:`${stats.total?(s.n/stats.total*100):0}%`,background:s.c,borderRadius:2,transition:"width .6s ease"}}/>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* CONTROLS */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:10,marginBottom:16,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        <div style={{position:"relative",flex:1,minWidth:180,maxWidth:320}}>
          <span style={{position:"absolute",left:10,top:"50%",transform:"translateY(-50%)",color:cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:13}}>🔍</span>
          <input value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="Buscar cliente, oferta, asunto..."
            style={{width:"100%",...cardStyle,borderRadius:9,padding:"8px 12px 8px 32px",color:cv("--text-main"),fontSize:12,outline:"none"}}/>
        </div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",...cardStyle,borderRadius:9,overflow:"hidden"}}>
          {["Todas","Recibida","En elaboración","Enviada"].map(f=>(
            <button key={f} onClick={()=>setFilter(f)} style={{padding:"7px 11px",background:filter===f?cv("--bg-pill"):"transparent",border:"none",color:filter===f?cv("--accent-soft"):cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:11,fontWeight:filter===f?600:400,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",transition:"all .15s"}}>{f}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* TABLE */}
      <div style={{...cardStyle,borderRadius:14,overflow:"hidden",boxShadow:theme==="light"?"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)":"none"}} className="fade-in">
        <table style={{width:"100%",borderCollapse:"collapse"}}>
          <thead>
            <tr style={{background:cv("--bg-input")}}>
              {["","Cliente","Oferta","Asunto correo","Responsable","Observación","Etapa","Estado","Fecha envío"].map(h=>(
                <th key={h} style={{padding:"11px 12px",textAlign:"left",fontSize:10,color:cv("--text-dim"),fontWeight:600,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"0.6px",borderBottom:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,whiteSpace:"nowrap"}}>{h}</th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {filtered.length===0?(
              <tr><td colSpan={9} style={{padding:48,textAlign:"center",color:cv("--text-faint")}}>
                {opps.length===0?"No hay oportunidades aún. ¡Crea la primera!":"No se encontraron resultados."}
              </td></tr>
            ):filtered.map(o=>(
              <tr key={o.id} onClick={()=>openOpp(o)} style={{cursor:"pointer",borderBottom:`1px solid ${cv("--border2")}`}}>
                <td style={{padding:"10px 12px"}}>
                  <button onClick={e=>{e.stopPropagation();updateStatus(o.id,o.status);}}
                    style={{width:14,height:14,borderRadius:"50%",background:SEMAFORO[o.status]?.color,border:"none",cursor:"pointer",flexShrink:0,display:"block"}} title={`Estado: ${SEMAFORO[o.status]?.label}`}/>
                </td>
                <td style={{padding:"10px 12px"}}>
                  <p style={{margin:0,fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:cv("--text-main")}}>{o.client_name||"—"}</p>
                </td>
                <td style={{padding:"10px 12px"}}>
                  <p style={{margin:0,fontSize:12,color:cv("--text-sub")}}>{o.name||<span style={{color:cv("--text-faint")}}>Sin nombre</span>}</p>
                </td>
                <td style={{padding:"10px 12px",maxWidth:220}}>
                  <p style={{margin:0,fontSize:11,color:cv("--text-dim"),overflow:"hidden",textOverflow:"ellipsis",whiteSpace:"nowrap"}}>{o.email_subject||"—"}</p>
                </td>
                <td style={{padding:"10px 12px"}}>
                  {o.assignee?<div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:6}}>
                    <div style={{width:22,height:22,borderRadius:"50%",background:avc(o.assignee.name),display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontSize:8,fontWeight:700,color:"white",flexShrink:0}}>{ini(o.assignee.name)}</div>
                    <span style={{fontSize:11,color:cv("--text-sub")}}>{o.assignee.name.split(" ")[0]}</span>
                  </div>:<span style={{color:cv("--text-faint"),fontSize:11}}>—</span>}
                </td>
                <td style={{padding:"10px 12px",maxWidth:180}}>
                  <p style={{margin:0,fontSize:11,color:cv("--text-dim"),overflow:"hidden",textOverflow:"ellipsis",whiteSpace:"nowrap"}}>{o.quick_note||"—"}</p>
                </td>
                <td style={{padding:"10px 12px"}}>
                  <button onClick={e=>{e.stopPropagation();updateStage(o.id,o.stage);}}
                    style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:5,background:STAGES[o.stage]?.bg,border:`1px solid ${STAGES[o.stage]?.color}44`,borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",whiteSpace:"nowrap"}}>
                    <div style={{width:6,height:6,borderRadius:"50%",background:STAGES[o.stage]?.color}}/>
                    <span style={{fontSize:11,fontWeight:600,color:STAGES[o.stage]?.color}}>{o.stage}</span>
                  </button>
                </td>
                <td style={{padding:"10px 12px"}}>
                  <div style={{width:12,height:12,borderRadius:"50%",background:SEMAFORO[o.status]?.color}}/>
                </td>
                <td style={{padding:"10px 12px",fontSize:11,color:cv("--text-dim"),fontFamily:"'DM Mono',monospace",whiteSpace:"nowrap"}}>{fd(o.sent_date)}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* MODAL DETALLE OPORTUNIDAD */}
      {selOpp&&(
        <div onClick={()=>setSelOpp(null)} style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.65)",zIndex:200,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",padding:20,backdropFilter:"blur(4px)"}}>
          <div onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()} style={{background:cv("--bg-card"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:18,width:"100%",maxWidth:680,maxHeight:"90vh",display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",boxShadow:"0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)"}} className="slide-in">

            {/* Header del modal */}
            <div style={{padding:"20px 24px 16px",borderBottom:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,display:"flex",alignItems:"flex-start",justifyContent:"space-between",flexShrink:0}}>
              <div style={{flex:1}}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:10,marginBottom:6}}>
                  <div style={{width:12,height:12,borderRadius:"50%",background:SEMAFORO[selOpp.status]?.color,cursor:"pointer",flexShrink:0}} onClick={()=>updateStatus(selOpp.id,selOpp.status)} title="Clic para cambiar estado"/>
                  <h2 style={{fontSize:18,fontWeight:700,color:cv("--text-main")}}>{selOpp.client_name}</h2>
                  <button onClick={()=>updateStage(selOpp.id,selOpp.stage)}
                    style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:5,background:STAGES[selOpp.stage]?.bg,border:`1px solid ${STAGES[selOpp.stage]?.color}44`,borderRadius:6,padding:"3px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                    <div style={{width:6,height:6,borderRadius:"50%",background:STAGES[selOpp.stage]?.color}}/>
                    <span style={{fontSize:11,fontWeight:600,color:STAGES[selOpp.stage]?.color}}>{selOpp.stage}</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
                {selOpp.name&&<p style={{fontSize:13,color:cv("--text-sub"),marginBottom:4}}>{selOpp.name}</p>}
                {selOpp.email_subject&&<p style={{fontSize:12,color:cv("--text-dim")}}>📧 {selOpp.email_subject}</p>}
              </div>
              <button onClick={()=>setSelOpp(null)} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:cv("--text-dim"),cursor:"pointer",fontSize:20,marginLeft:16,flexShrink:0}}>✕</button>
            </div>

            {/* Info rápida */}
            <div style={{padding:"12px 24px",borderBottom:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,display:"flex",gap:20,flexShrink:0,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
              {[
                {l:"Responsable",v:selOpp.assignee?.name||"Sin asignar"},
                {l:"Fecha envío",v:fdl(selOpp.sent_date)},
                {l:"Observación",v:selOpp.quick_note||"—"},
              ].map(f=>(
                <div key={f.l} style={{flex:1,minWidth:140}}>
                  <p style={{margin:"0 0 2px",fontSize:10,color:cv("--text-dim"),textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"0.5px"}}>{f.l}</p>
                  <p style={{margin:0,fontSize:12,fontWeight:600,color:cv("--text-main")}}>{f.v}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Comentarios */}
            <div style={{flex:1,overflowY:"auto",padding:"16px 24px"}}>
              <p style={{fontSize:11,color:cv("--text-dim"),textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"0.6px",marginBottom:12}}>Historial de actividad</p>
              {loadingComments?(
                <p style={{color:cv("--text-faint"),fontSize:12,textAlign:"center",padding:20}}>Cargando...</p>
              ):comments.length===0?(
                <p style={{color:cv("--text-faint"),fontSize:12,textAlign:"center",padding:20}}>Sin actividad aún. ¡Agrega el primer comentario!</p>
              ):comments.map(c=>(
                <div key={c.id} style={{display:"flex",gap:10,marginBottom:16}}>
                  <div style={{width:28,height:28,borderRadius:"50%",background:avc(c.user?.name||"?"),display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontSize:9,fontWeight:700,color:"white",flexShrink:0}}>{ini(c.user?.name||"?")}</div>
                  <div style={{flex:1}}>
                    <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8,marginBottom:4}}>
                      <span style={{fontSize:12,fontWeight:600,color:cv("--text-main")}}>{c.user?.name||"Usuario"}</span>
                      <span style={{fontSize:10,color:cv("--text-faint")}}>{fdt(c.created_at)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{background:cv("--bg-input"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px"}}>
                      <p style={{margin:0,fontSize:13,color:cv("--text-sub"),lineHeight:1.5}}>{c.comment}</p>
                      {c.files&&c.files.length>0&&c.files.map(f=>(
                        <button key={f.id} onClick={()=>downloadFile(f.storage_path,f.original_name)}
                          style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:6,marginTop:8,background:cv("--bg-pill"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:6,padding:"5px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",color:cv("--accent-soft"),fontSize:11,fontWeight:600}}>
                          📎 {f.original_name}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Input comentario */}
            <div style={{padding:"12px 24px 20px",borderTop:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,flexShrink:0}}>
              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"flex-end"}}>
                <div style={{flex:1}}>
                  <textarea value={newComment} onChange={e=>setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Escribe un comentario o pasa el balón..."
                    style={{width:"100%",background:cv("--bg-input"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 12px",color:cv("--text-main"),fontSize:13,outline:"none",resize:"none",minHeight:70,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
                  {commentFile&&(
                    <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:6,marginTop:6,background:cv("--bg-pill"),borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 10px",fontSize:11,color:cv("--accent-soft")}}>
                      📎 {commentFile.name}
                      <button onClick={()=>setCommentFile(null)} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:cv("--text-faint"),cursor:"pointer",fontSize:14,marginLeft:4}}>✕</button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:6}}>
                  <button onClick={()=>fileRef.current.click()}
                    style={{padding:"10px 12px",background:cv("--bg-pill"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:10,cursor:"pointer",color:cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:16}} title="Adjuntar archivo">📎</button>
                  <input ref={fileRef} type="file" style={{display:"none"}} onChange={e=>setCommentFile(e.target.files[0])}/>
                  <Btn onClick={addComment} disabled={saving||(!newComment.trim()&&!commentFile)} style={{padding:"10px 16px"}}>
                    {saving?"...":"↑"}
                  </Btn>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"flex-end",marginTop:10}}>
                <Btn variant="danger" onClick={()=>deleteOpp(selOpp.id)} style={{fontSize:12,padding:"6px 14px"}}>Eliminar oportunidad</Btn>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODAL NUEVA OPORTUNIDAD */}
      {showNew&&(
        <div onClick={()=>setShowNew(false)} style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.65)",zIndex:200,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",padding:20,backdropFilter:"blur(4px)"}}>
          <div onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()} style={{background:cv("--bg-card"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:18,width:"100%",maxWidth:500,padding:26,maxHeight:"90vh",overflowY:"auto",boxShadow:"0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)"}} className="slide-in">
            <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:20}}>
              <h2 style={{fontSize:17,fontWeight:700,color:cv("--text-main")}}>Nueva oportunidad</h2>
              <button onClick={()=>setShowNew(false)} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:cv("--text-dim"),cursor:"pointer",fontSize:20}}>✕</button>
            </div>
            <Inp label="Cliente *" placeholder="Nombre del cliente" value={no.client_name} onChange={e=>setNo({...no,client_name:e.target.value})}/>
            <Inp label="Nombre / descripción oferta" placeholder="Ej: Cotización válvulas presión" value={no.name} onChange={e=>setNo({...no,name:e.target.value})}/>
            <Inp label="Asunto del correo" placeholder="Asunto del correo recibido" value={no.email_subject} onChange={e=>setNo({...no,email_subject:e.target.value})}/>
            <Inp label="Observación rápida" placeholder="Nota corta importante" value={no.quick_note} onChange={e=>setNo({...no,quick_note:e.target.value})}/>
            <Inp label="Fecha de envío" type="date" value={no.sent_date} onChange={e=>setNo({...no,sent_date:e.target.value})}/>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
              <Sel label="Etapa" value={no.stage} onChange={e=>setNo({...no,stage:e.target.value})}>
                {["Recibida","En elaboración","Enviada"].map(s=><option key={s}>{s}</option>)}
              </Sel>
              <Sel label="Responsable" value={no.assignee_id} onChange={e=>setNo({...no,assignee_id:e.target.value})}>
                <option value="">Sin asignar</option>
                {users.map(u=><option key={u.id} value={u.id}>{u.name}</option>)}
              </Sel>
              <Sel label="Estado" value={no.status} onChange={e=>setNo({...no,status:e.target.value})}>
                {Object.entries(SEMAFORO).map(([k,v])=><option key={k} value={k}>{v.label}</option>)}
              </Sel>
            </div>
            <Btn onClick={createOpp} disabled={saving||!no.client_name} style={{width:"100%",marginTop:6,padding:"12px",fontSize:14}}>
              {saving?"Guardando...":"Crear oportunidad"}
            </Btn>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── MAIN APP ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function App(){
  const [theme,setTheme]     =useState(()=>localStorage.getItem("wcrm-theme")||"dark");
  const [session,setSession] =useState(null);
  const [ready,setReady]     =useState(false);
  const [tasks,setTasks]     =useState([]);
  const [projects,setProjects]=useState([]);
  const [users,setUsers]     =useState([]);
  const [module,setModule]   =useState("tareas");
  const [view,setView]       =useState("tabla");
  const [filter,setFilter]   =useState("Todas");
  const [search,setSearch]   =useState("");
  const [selTask,setSelTask] =useState(null);
  const [showNew,setShowNew] =useState(false);
  const [saving,setSaving]   =useState(false);
  const [nt,setNt]           =useState({title:"",description:"",assignee_id:"",project_id:"",deadline:"",status:"Pendiente",priority:"Media"});

  useEffect(()=>{document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme",theme);localStorage.setItem("wcrm-theme",theme);},[theme]);
  const toggleTheme=()=>setTheme(t=>t==="dark"?"light":"dark");

  useEffect(()=>{
    db.auth.getSession().then(({data:{session}})=>{setSession(session);setReady(true);});
    const{data:{subscription}}=db.auth.onAuthStateChange((_,s)=>setSession(s));
    return()=>subscription.unsubscribe();
  },[]);

  useEffect(()=>{if(session)fetchAll();},[session]);

  const fetchAll=async()=>{
    const[t,p,u]=await Promise.all([
      db.from("tasks").select("*, assignee:users(id,name), project:projects(id,name,color)").order("updated_at",{ascending:false}),
      db.from("projects").select("*").order("name"),
      db.from("users").select("*").eq("active",true).order("name"),
    ]);
    setTasks(t.data||[]);setProjects(p.data||[]);setUsers(u.data||[]);
  };

  const createTask=async()=>{
    if(!nt.title)return;setSaving(true);
    await db.from("tasks").insert({...nt,assignee_id:nt.assignee_id||null,project_id:nt.project_id||null,deadline:nt.deadline||null,created_by:session.user.id});
    await fetchAll();setShowNew(false);
    setNt({title:"",description:"",assignee_id:"",project_id:"",deadline:"",status:"Pendiente",priority:"Media"});
    setSaving(false);
  };

  const nextStatus=async(id,cur)=>{
    const order=["Pendiente","En progreso","Completado"];
    const next=order[(order.indexOf(cur)+1)%3];
    await db.from("tasks").update({status:next}).eq("id",id);
    setTasks(tasks.map(t=>t.id===id?{...t,status:next}:t));
    if(selTask?.id===id)setSelTask({...selTask,status:next});
  };

  const deleteTask=async(id)=>{
    if(!confirm("¿Eliminar esta tarea?"))return;
    await db.from("tasks").delete().eq("id",id);
    setTasks(tasks.filter(t=>t.id!==id));setSelTask(null);
  };

  const filteredTasks=tasks.filter(t=>(filter==="Todas"||t.status===filter)&&(!search||t.title?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())||t.assignee?.name?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())));
  const stats={total:tasks.length,pend:tasks.filter(t=>t.status==="Pendiente").length,prog:tasks.filter(t=>t.status==="En progreso").length,done:tasks.filter(t=>t.status==="Completado").length};
  const uname=session?.user?.user_metadata?.name||session?.user?.email?.split("@")[0]||"Usuario";
  const logo=theme==="dark"?`data:image/png;base64,${LOGO_DARK}`:`data:image/png;base64,${LOGO_LIGHT}`;

  if(!ready)return<div style={{height:"100vh",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}><div style={{fontSize:28,color:cv("--accent"),animation:"spin 1s linear infinite"}}>◎</div><p style={{color:cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:13}}>Cargando CRM Weisz...</p></div>;
  if(!session)return<AuthScreen theme={theme} toggleTheme={toggleTheme}/>;

  const sbStyle={background:cv("--bg-sidebar"),borderRight:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,transition:"background .3s,border-color .3s"};
  const cardStyle={background:cv("--bg-card"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,transition:"background .3s,border-color .3s"};

  const NAV=[
    {key:"tareas",icon:"✓",label:"Tareas"},
    {key:"oportunidades",icon:"📋",label:"Oportunidades"},
  ];

  return(
    <div style={{display:"flex",minHeight:"100vh",background:cv("--bg-main"),transition:"background .3s"}}>
      {/* SIDEBAR */}
      <aside style={{width:224,...sbStyle,display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",position:"fixed",top:0,bottom:0,left:0,zIndex:50,boxShadow:theme==="light"?"2px 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)":"none"}}>
        <div style={{padding:"18px 16px 14px",borderBottom:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`}}>
          <img src={logo} alt="Weisz CRM" style={{height:38,maxWidth:180,objectFit:"contain",transition:"opacity .3s"}}/>
        </div>
        <nav style={{padding:"12px 10px",flex:1,overflowY:"auto"}}>
          {NAV.map(item=>(
            <div key={item.key} onClick={()=>setModule(item.key)}
              style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:10,padding:"9px 12px",borderRadius:8,marginBottom:2,background:module===item.key?cv("--bg-pill"):"transparent",color:module===item.key?cv("--accent-soft"):cv("--text-dim"),cursor:"pointer",fontSize:13,fontWeight:module===item.key?600:400,transition:"all .15s"}}>
              <span>{item.icon}</span>{item.label}
            </div>
          ))}
          <div style={{marginTop:20,padding:"0 4px"}}>
            <p style={{fontSize:10,color:cv("--text-faint"),textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"0.8px",marginBottom:8,padding:"0 8px"}}>Proyectos</p>
            {projects.map(p=>(
              <div key={p.id} style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8,padding:"6px 12px",borderRadius:6,cursor:"pointer",fontSize:12,color:cv("--text-dim"),marginBottom:2}}>
                <div style={{width:7,height:7,borderRadius:"50%",background:p.color,flexShrink:0}}/>{p.name}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </nav>
        <div style={{padding:"12px 16px",borderTop:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:12,padding:"8px 10px",background:cv("--bg-input"),borderRadius:8}}>
            <span style={{fontSize:11,color:cv("--text-dim")}}>{theme==="dark"?"🌙 Oscuro":"☀️ Claro"}</span>
            <button onClick={toggleTheme} className="toggle-btn" title="Cambiar tema"/>
          </div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:10,marginBottom:10}}>
            <div style={{width:30,height:30,borderRadius:"50%",background:avc(uname),display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontSize:10,fontWeight:700,flexShrink:0,color:"white"}}>{ini(uname)}</div>
            <div style={{flex:1,minWidth:0}}>
              <p style={{margin:0,fontSize:12,fontWeight:600,color:cv("--text-main"),overflow:"hidden",textOverflow:"ellipsis",whiteSpace:"nowrap"}}>{uname}</p>
              <p style={{margin:0,fontSize:10,color:cv("--text-dim")}}>Miembro activo</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={()=>db.auth.signOut()} style={{width:"100%",padding:"7px",background:cv("--bg-pill"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:7,color:cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:11,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Cerrar sesión</button>
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* MAIN */}
      <main style={{marginLeft:224,flex:1,padding:"0 28px 40px"}}>

        {/* ── MÓDULO TAREAS ── */}
        {module==="tareas"&&(
          <div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"space-between",padding:"22px 0 18px",borderBottom:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,marginBottom:24}}>
              <div>
                <h1 style={{fontSize:20,fontWeight:700,letterSpacing:"-0.5px",marginBottom:3,color:cv("--text-main")}}>Seguimiento de Tareas</h1>
                <p style={{color:cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:12}}>{new Date().toLocaleDateString("es-CO",{weekday:"long",year:"numeric",month:"long",day:"numeric"})}</p>
              </div>
              <button onClick={()=>setShowNew(true)} style={{background:`linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2))`,border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"9px 18px",color:"white",fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",boxShadow:`0 4px 20px var(--shadow)`}}>
                + Nueva tarea
              </button>
            </div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(4,1fr)",gap:14,marginBottom:24}}>
              {[{l:"Total tareas",n:stats.total,c:"var(--accent)"},{l:"Pendientes",n:stats.pend,c:"#f59e0b"},{l:"En progreso",n:stats.prog,c:"#3b82f6"},{l:"Completadas",n:stats.done,c:"#10b981"}].map(s=>(
                <div key={s.l} style={{...cardStyle,borderRadius:12,padding:"16px 18px",boxShadow:theme==="light"?"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)":"none"}}>
                  <p style={{color:cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:10,marginBottom:6,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"0.5px"}}>{s.l}</p>
                  <p style={{fontSize:30,fontWeight:700,marginBottom:10,color:s.c,fontFamily:"'DM Mono',monospace"}}>{s.n}</p>
                  <div style={{height:3,background:cv("--bg-pill"),borderRadius:2}}>
                    <div style={{height:"100%",width:`${stats.total?(s.n/stats.total*100):0}%`,background:s.c,borderRadius:2,transition:"width .6s ease"}}/>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:10,marginBottom:16,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
              <div style={{position:"relative",flex:1,minWidth:180,maxWidth:280}}>
                <span style={{position:"absolute",left:10,top:"50%",transform:"translateY(-50%)",color:cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:13}}>🔍</span>
                <input value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="Buscar tarea o persona..." style={{width:"100%",...cardStyle,borderRadius:9,padding:"8px 12px 8px 32px",color:cv("--text-main"),fontSize:12,outline:"none"}}/>
              </div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",...cardStyle,borderRadius:9,overflow:"hidden"}}>
                {["Todas","Pendiente","En progreso","Completado"].map(f=>(
                  <button key={f} onClick={()=>setFilter(f)} style={{padding:"7px 11px",background:filter===f?cv("--bg-pill"):"transparent",border:"none",color:filter===f?cv("--accent-soft"):cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:11,fontWeight:filter===f?600:400,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",transition:"all .15s"}}>{f}</button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",...cardStyle,borderRadius:9,overflow:"hidden"}}>
                {[{k:"tabla",i:"☰"},{k:"kanban",i:"⊞"}].map(vw=>(
                  <button key={vw.k} onClick={()=>setView(vw.k)} style={{padding:"7px 13px",background:view===vw.k?cv("--bg-pill"):"transparent",border:"none",color:view===vw.k?cv("--accent-soft"):cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:16,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{vw.i}</button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            {view==="tabla"&&(
              <div style={{...cardStyle,borderRadius:14,overflow:"hidden",boxShadow:theme==="light"?"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)":"none"}} className="fade-in">
                <table style={{width:"100%",borderCollapse:"collapse"}}>
                  <thead><tr style={{background:cv("--bg-input")}}>
                    {["Tarea","Responsable","Proyecto","Fecha","Prioridad","Estado",""].map(h=>(
                      <th key={h} style={{padding:"11px 14px",textAlign:"left",fontSize:10,color:cv("--text-dim"),fontWeight:600,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"0.6px",borderBottom:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`}}>{h}</th>
                    ))}
                  </tr></thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filteredTasks.length===0?(
                      <tr><td colSpan={7} style={{padding:48,textAlign:"center",color:cv("--text-faint")}}>{tasks.length===0?"No hay tareas aún. ¡Crea la primera!":"No se encontraron tareas."}</td></tr>
                    ):filteredTasks.map(t=>(
                      <tr key={t.id} onClick={()=>setSelTask(t)} style={{cursor:"pointer",borderBottom:`1px solid ${cv("--border2")}`}}>
                        <td style={{padding:"13px 14px"}}><p style={{margin:0,fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:cv("--text-main")}}>{t.title}</p>{t.description&&<p style={{margin:"2px 0 0",color:cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:11}}>{t.description.slice(0,50)}{t.description.length>50?"...":""}</p>}</td>
                        <td style={{padding:"13px 14px"}}>{t.assignee?<div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:7}}><div style={{width:24,height:24,borderRadius:"50%",background:avc(t.assignee.name),display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontSize:8,fontWeight:700,flexShrink:0,color:"white"}}>{ini(t.assignee.name)}</div><span style={{fontSize:12,color:cv("--text-sub")}}>{t.assignee.name.split(" ")[0]}</span></div>:<span style={{color:cv("--text-faint"),fontSize:12}}>—</span>}</td>
                        <td style={{padding:"13px 14px"}}>{t.project?<span style={{fontSize:11,color:t.project.color,background:t.project.color+"22",padding:"3px 8px",borderRadius:5,fontWeight:600}}>{t.project.name}</span>:<span style={{color:cv("--text-faint"),fontSize:12}}>—</span>}</td>
                        <td style={{padding:"13px 14px",fontSize:12,color:cv("--text-dim"),fontFamily:"'DM Mono',monospace"}}>{fd(t.deadline)}</td>
                        <td style={{padding:"13px 14px"}}><span style={{fontSize:11,fontWeight:600,color:PR[t.priority]?.color,background:PR[t.priority]?.bg,padding:"3px 9px",borderRadius:5}}>{t.priority}</span></td>
                        <td style={{padding:"13px 14px"}}><button onClick={e=>{e.stopPropagation();nextStatus(t.id,t.status);}} style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:5,background:ST[t.status]?.bg,border:`1px solid ${ST[t.status]?.color}44`,borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit"}}><div style={{width:6,height:6,borderRadius:"50%",background:ST[t.status]?.dot}}/><span style={{fontSize:11,fontWeight:600,color:ST[t.status]?.color}}>{t.status}</span></button></td>
                        <td style={{padding:"13px 8px"}}><button onClick={e=>{e.stopPropagation();deleteTask(t.id);}} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:cv("--text-faint"),cursor:"pointer",fontSize:14,padding:"4px 8px",borderRadius:6,transition:"color .15s"}} onMouseEnter={e=>e.target.style.color="#ef4444"} onMouseLeave={e=>e.target.style.color="var(--text-faint)"}>✕</button></td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
            {view==="kanban"&&(
              <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(3,1fr)",gap:14}} className="fade-in">
                {["Pendiente","En progreso","Completado"].map(col=>{
                  const ct=filteredTasks.filter(t=>t.status===col);
                  return(
                    <div key={col} style={{...cardStyle,borderRadius:14,overflow:"hidden"}}>
                      <div style={{padding:"13px 14px",borderBottom:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"space-between"}}>
                        <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8}}><div style={{width:7,height:7,borderRadius:"50%",background:ST[col].dot}}/><span style={{fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:cv("--text-main")}}>{col}</span></div>
                        <span style={{background:cv("--bg-pill"),color:cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,padding:"2px 8px",borderRadius:20}}>{ct.length}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{padding:10,display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8,minHeight:100}}>
                        {ct.map(t=>(
                          <div key={t.id} onClick={()=>setSelTask(t)} style={{background:cv("--bg-input"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:10,padding:12,cursor:"pointer",transition:"border-color .15s"}} onMouseEnter={e=>{e.currentTarget.style.borderColor=ST[col].dot+"88"}} onMouseLeave={e=>{e.currentTarget.style.borderColor="var(--border)"}}>
                            <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:7,alignItems:"center"}}>
                              {t.project&&<span style={{fontSize:10,color:t.project.color,background:t.project.color+"22",padding:"2px 7px",borderRadius:4,fontWeight:600}}>{t.project.name}</span>}
                              <span style={{fontSize:10,fontWeight:600,color:PR[t.priority]?.color,marginLeft:"auto"}}>{t.priority}</span>
                            </div>
                            <p style={{margin:"0 0 8px",fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,lineHeight:1.4,color:cv("--text-main")}}>{t.title}</p>
                            <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"space-between"}}>
                              {t.assignee&&<div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:5}}><div style={{width:20,height:20,borderRadius:"50%",background:avc(t.assignee.name),display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontSize:7,fontWeight:700,color:"white"}}>{ini(t.assignee.name)}</div><span style={{fontSize:11,color:cv("--text-dim")}}>{t.assignee.name.split(" ")[0]}</span></div>}
                              <span style={{fontSize:10,color:cv("--text-faint"),fontFamily:"'DM Mono',monospace",marginLeft:"auto"}}>{fd(t.deadline)}</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                        {ct.length===0&&<p style={{textAlign:"center",color:cv("--text-faint"),fontSize:12,padding:20}}>Sin tareas</p>}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ── MÓDULO OPORTUNIDADES ── */}
        {module==="oportunidades"&&<OpportunitiesModule users={users} session={session} theme={theme}/>}
      </main>

      {/* MODAL DETALLE TAREA */}
      {selTask&&(
        <div onClick={()=>setSelTask(null)} style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.6)",zIndex:200,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",padding:20,backdropFilter:"blur(4px)"}}>
          <div onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()} style={{background:cv("--bg-card"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:18,width:"100%",maxWidth:500,padding:26,maxHeight:"90vh",overflowY:"auto",boxShadow:"0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)"}} className="slide-in">
            <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:16}}>
              {selTask.project&&<span style={{fontSize:11,color:selTask.project.color,background:selTask.project.color+"22",padding:"3px 10px",borderRadius:6,fontWeight:600}}>{selTask.project.name}</span>}
              <button onClick={()=>setSelTask(null)} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:cv("--text-dim"),cursor:"pointer",fontSize:20,marginLeft:"auto"}}>✕</button>
            </div>
            <h2 style={{fontSize:19,fontWeight:700,marginBottom:8,color:cv("--text-main")}}>{selTask.title}</h2>
            {selTask.description&&<p style={{color:cv("--text-dim"),fontSize:13,marginBottom:20,lineHeight:1.6}}>{selTask.description}</p>}
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12,marginBottom:20}}>
              {[{l:"Responsable",val:selTask.assignee?.name||"Sin asignar"},{l:"Fecha límite",val:fd(selTask.deadline)},{l:"Estado",val:selTask.status,c:ST[selTask.status]?.color},{l:"Prioridad",val:selTask.priority,c:PR[selTask.priority]?.color}].map(f=>(
                <div key={f.l} style={{background:cv("--bg-input"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:9,padding:"11px 13px"}}>
                  <p style={{margin:"0 0 3px",fontSize:10,color:cv("--text-dim"),textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:"0.5px"}}>{f.l}</p>
                  <p style={{margin:0,fontSize:13,fontWeight:600,color:f.c||cv("--text-main")}}>{f.val}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10}}>
              <Btn onClick={()=>nextStatus(selTask.id,selTask.status)} style={{flex:1}}>Avanzar estado →</Btn>
              <Btn variant="danger" onClick={()=>deleteTask(selTask.id)}>Eliminar</Btn>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODAL NUEVA TAREA */}
      {showNew&&module==="tareas"&&(
        <div onClick={()=>setShowNew(false)} style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.6)",zIndex:200,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",padding:20,backdropFilter:"blur(4px)"}}>
          <div onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()} style={{background:cv("--bg-card"),border:`1px solid ${cv("--border")}`,borderRadius:18,width:"100%",maxWidth:460,padding:26,maxHeight:"90vh",overflowY:"auto",boxShadow:"0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)"}} className="slide-in">
            <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:20}}>
              <h2 style={{fontSize:17,fontWeight:700,color:cv("--text-main")}}>Nueva tarea</h2>
              <button onClick={()=>setShowNew(false)} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:cv("--text-dim"),cursor:"pointer",fontSize:20}}>✕</button>
            </div>
            <Inp label="Título *" placeholder="Nombre de la tarea" value={nt.title} onChange={e=>setNt({...nt,title:e.target.value})}/>
            <Inp label="Descripción" placeholder="Descripción breve" value={nt.description} onChange={e=>setNt({...nt,description:e.target.value})}/>
            <Inp label="Fecha límite" type="date" value={nt.deadline} onChange={e=>setNt({...nt,deadline:e.target.value})}/>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
              <Sel label="Responsable" value={nt.assignee_id} onChange={e=>setNt({...nt,assignee_id:e.target.value})}><option value="">Sin asignar</option>{users.map(u=><option key={u.id} value={u.id}>{u.name}</option>)}</Sel>
              <Sel label="Proyecto" value={nt.project_id} onChange={e=>setNt({...nt,project_id:e.target.value})}><option value="">Sin proyecto</option>{projects.map(p=><option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>)}</Sel>
              <Sel label="Estado" value={nt.status} onChange={e=>setNt({...nt,status:e.target.value})}>{["Pendiente","En progreso","Completado"].map(s=><option key={s}>{s}</option>)}</Sel>
              <Sel label="Prioridad" value={nt.priority} onChange={e=>setNt({...nt,priority:e.target.value})}>{["Alta","Media","Baja"].map(p=><option key={p}>{p}</option>)}</Sel>
            </div>
            <Btn onClick={createTask} disabled={saving||!nt.title} style={{width:"100%",marginTop:6,padding:"12px",fontSize:14}}>{saving?"Guardando...":"Crear tarea"}</Btn>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById("root")).render(<App/>);
</script>
</body>
</html>
